# Recreation Prompt

Recreate `Rift Riders: Midnight Signal` as a mobile-first portrait browser game. Preserve the source mechanics exactly: virtual joystick top-down movement, rectangular obstacle collision rollback, roam state, gate/summon button with delayed boss spawn, attack button with short melee/ranged-feeling strike window, parry button with active frames and cooldown, boss chase/slash/projectile AI, player HP, boss HP, win, fail, and restart states.

Transform the presentation into: Stranger Things sci-fi horror adventure. A Stranger Things sci-fi horror adventure game with small-town mystery, 80s nostalgia, supernatural portals, bike-riding teens, synth dread, friendship-driven quests, and shadow-monster suspense with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

The focal avatar is a bike-riding teen in a neon jacket with a flashlight/radio beam. The gate is a red supernatural portal tuned by radio static. The boss is an angular shadow monster. HP is friendship signal. Attacks are flashlight bursts. Parry is a Friend Link psychic block. The world is a procedural 1980s small-town midnight street with VHS scanlines, porch lights, lab barricades, red rift spores, cyan radio glow, and synth-horror UI typography.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: Mobile-first top-down action combat with free-roam exploration leading into a boss fight.
- objective: Start in a roaming map, activate a summon/gate button, survive the boss phase, damage the boss with attacks, and win when boss HP reaches zero.
- input model: Touch-first virtual joystick for movement, touch/click action buttons for attack, summon, and parry; keyboard is not a primary active path in the preserved source.
- core loop: Roam around rectangular obstacles, activate a delayed gate/portal, fight a pursuing boss that alternates chase, slash, and projectile behavior, use attack and parry, then reach victory or failure.
- fail/friction state: Player HP decreases from boss slashes/projectiles; HP <= 0 triggers game over overlay and restart.

## Protected mechanics
- Joystick movement speed, parry movement lock, obstacle rollback collision, attack timer/range, parry active frames/cooldown, summon delay, boss HP/player HP values, boss chase/slash/projectile states, projectile lifetime/speed, damage amounts, win/fail/restart state flow.

## Remixed target
`Rift Riders: Midnight Signal` reframes the same mechanics as bike-riding teens in a haunted 1980s small town. The summon gate becomes a radio-tuned supernatural portal, the boss becomes a shadow monster, attack becomes a flashlight beam strike, parry becomes a friendship/psychic link block, HP becomes friendship signal, and the canvas world becomes a procedural neon-night neighborhood with rift spores and VHS dread.
